speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you're a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; this is urgent. Can you tell me exactly how many days old your baby is, and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus. The history of bilious vomiting in a newborn born at term, combined with a sibling with pyloric stenosis, raises suspicion for midgut volvulus; immediate surgical evaluation is required.
